0x000752.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x000784.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is the limit...!」

0x0007F5.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x00087D.en: 「Dammit! Next time you won't get me!」

0x0008F7.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x0009DE.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000AA7.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000AE2.en: 「To screw up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000B36.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000C20.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000C87.en: 「This is the end... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D33.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000D80.en: 「Well, that's a bother. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DBE.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E05.en: 「For the Granzon to fall... how unexpected...」

0x000EB0.en: 「Ngh... to think I'd be the shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x000F67.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give up, I miscalculated.」

0x000FA8.en: 「Oh boy, they went and got me!」

0x000FEC.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x001059.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010A0.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x0010D5.en: 「Dammit! So this is the limit of my power...!」

0x001192.en: 「Ngh... you're as good as they say.」

0x0011C1.en: 「To lose in a place like this...@　I'm not there yet...!」

0x00120F.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0012CA.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0012F9.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001337.en: 「Well now, so this is the end.」

0x001366.en: 「I can't go any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x0013F1.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x001557.en: 「Ejecting...@　Ngh...! I can't even look cool doing it...」

0x001615.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018A9.en: Paris - Earth Federation Army - Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x0018D7.en: Earth Federation Army - Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x00190C.en: 「......Good timing, Daniel.@　If the car had passed the front gate, you'd have gotten homesick.」

0x00199F.en: 「My apologies, Marshal.@　Ruining such a fine dinner party......」

0x0019EC.en: 「Never mind. Thanks to this,@ I won't have to open a bottle of d'Yquem's Sauternes.」

0x001A6A.en: 「Forty years. Ah, and one more thing...@ I'd like a present for my grandchild sent to my own house.@ See to the arrangements.」

0x001AFE.en: 「Now then, what about this giant structure?」

0x001B29.en: 「A rock mass roughly 4km long. It appeared over the Nafud Desert, Arabian Peninsula, at 0434 today, still climbing at ~40 kph.」

0x001BEF.en: 「Current altitude is 51km, just past the stratosphere. I'll show footage from the Reconquista allied space fleet's telescope.」

0x001CED.en: 「......After the clockwork star and the sword, a hanging garden.@　They're never short on spectacle.」

0x001D8A.en: 「Like the Tower of Babel.@　Historians and archaeologists will be beside themselves.」

0x001E70.en: 「I'll show you the footage that was just@　sent our way.」

0x001ECD.en: 「......Well now, gentlemen of the Earth Federation. Are you happy?@　My name is Son Ganglong, boss of Baral.」

0x001F47.en: 「Now, as you all know,@　our stronghold, the 'Garden of Baral,'@　has surfaced at long last.」

0x001FC8.en: 「The preparations gave us all sorts of trouble,@　but I think it's about time we put our plan into motion.」

0x002042.en: 「That said, there's no need to worry.@　We of Baral are the guardians of Earth.@　We mean to extend a helping hand to you.」

0x0020ED.en: 「Of course, we want nothing in return.@　All you need do is stay quiet and wait@　for the god of Baral to awaken.」

0x00217D.en: 「Yes, just bear with us a little longer......@　and your standing will rise, and you'll live@　merry, carefree lives in an earthly paradise.」

0x002225.en: 「It's the utopia mankind has always longed for.@　No more cowering before outside enemies.@　You'll live in peace, for all eternity.」

0x0022CA.en: 「Oh, and once the god of Baral awakens,@　we'll deal with the Ruina and the Guests.@　You needn't lift a finger.」

0x002369.en: 「Calm your hearts, stand up straight,@　and wait for the moment your existence is elevated.」

0x0023DA.en: 「And one more thing... attacking the Garden of Baral is useless. Feel free to try, if you don't believe me.」

0x002497.en: 「In any case, the time will come soon.@　Under our god, let's all be happy together.」

0x002508.en: 「That's all from Son Ganglong at the Garden of Baral!@　Ahahahaha!」

0x00256A.en: 「Hmph...... quite the elaborate promotion.@　He'll get an invite to Cannes next year.」

0x0025DB.en: 「Part of what he said matches the Baral report@　that came from intelligence.」

0x002643.en: 「Ah, the Steel Dragon Squadron clashed@　with their members, didn't they.」

0x00269C.en: 「These are people who can push a rock mass that size@　to the stratosphere. That footage was no mere bluff.」

0x002728.en: 「We can't rule out that it's some idle fool's hoax......@　but we may have to accept that hanging garden as reality.」

0x0027C3.en: 「Yes.@　To be safe, I believe we should issue a renewed@　high-alert order to all forces.」

0x002835.en: 「Granted. But until the details are clear,@　keep the alert targets to the Guests and Ruina.」

0x0028F3.en: 「So far it seems only we received the footage, though it may well have been sent to the Gaia Sabers too.」

0x0029BD.en: 「How shall we handle the Garden of Baral?」

0x002A00.en: 「......The allied space fleet@　had the H-MAPW, didn't it?」

0x002A50.en: 「Sir. Simulations, including the aftermath of@　target destruction, are already built in several patterns.」

0x002ACD.en: 「Then begin attack preparations at once.@　I'll request President Hendricks' authorization@　for use under Case E.」

0x002B4E.en: （......The reason Son Ganglong sent that footage......@　Stalling for time, or perhaps......）

0x002C0F.en: 「Commander Humphrey,@　loading of H-MAPW units one through six@　is complete.」

0x002D1C.en: 「......They must have noticed us by now.@　And yet they make no move against us......」

0x002DA2.en: 「Commander, we've received orders from the Joint Chiefs of Staff.」

0x002DEB.en: 「Send them here.@　Captain, we'll verify the authentication code.」

0x002E7A.en: 「Good. Authorization to use the H-MAPW is granted.@　Commence the attack at once!」
